title: Sri Lanka Couple Escape
headline: Bentota beaches, then a night in Colombo.
description: Three nights for two: two on Bentota’s west-coast sand, then Colombo before the flight home.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your dates and hotels
price_guidance: A short west-coast close. Hotel category and whether you add a river boat or city evening change the written total.
overview: A compact couple’s Sri Lanka: two nights on Bentota beach, then Colombo for a last dinner and an easy airport morning. Built for a long weekend or a first look at the island.
highlights: Two nights on Bentota or a neighbouring west-coast beach.
Private transfers from and to Colombo airport.
A Colombo evening — Galle Face or a neighbourhood dinner.
Pace kept short enough for a long weekend.
why: The shortest island stay that still feels like a holiday.
Beach first; the city is only a night.
ETA guidance for Indian passports, coordinated with your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and inter-hotel transfers in a private vehicle
exclusions: River boats, water sports and city tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
notes: Beach hotel and Colombo neighbourhood are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested order: Bentota, then Colombo. A third beach night can replace the city if you prefer.
